more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured drinks, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Made by treating partially hydrolysed starch with a microbial cycloglycosyltransferase enzyme. The product consists of rings containing seven glucose units.
more_info.side_effects:
Refined food-use estimates exceeded the limit for several groups.
The reviewed animal studies did not indicate genotoxicity or cancer; the limit incorporates a safety margin.
more_info.overview: Beta-cyclodextrin is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
